integrity: The correction follows directly from the source factorization and sign conditions and from the standard zero-eigenvalue requirement for a saddle-node.
No finite numerical experiment is used to prove the claim.
Exact-title, DOI, equilibrium-label, equivalent-formulation, and broader-coverage searches were compared before acceptance.
scientific_limitations: The stable two-dimensional block conclusion uses the source-displayed inequalities B1<0 and B2>0; outside them that block needs separate classification.
The result is local and spectral; it does not establish global persistence or classify other equilibria or bifurcation parameters.
The verified public date is the publisher online date 2025-12-30; no earlier public preprint was located.
title: A hyperbolic invasion saddle at the first-prey-free equilibrium
